product_metadata.title: Under Armour Lunch Box, Check Point
features: Adjustable, molded rubber handle with easy to use side clip
IsoTec premium closed cell PE foam insulation
Exterior zippered and slit pockets, and interior mesh pocket for ample storage
Completely PVC Free; constructed of 420 Denier polyester
PEVA lining with UA embossed easy-clean liner
description: The ultimate sports performance brand, Under Armor, has teamed up with Thermos to bring you the ultimate in durable lunch coolers for the active lifestyle. Each cooler comes with an adjustable, ergonomic plastic molded handle as well as an easy-to-use side clip. Storage is never a problem with multiple pockets - zippered and mesh on the exterior - and one interior mesh pocket. The interior is comprised of a durable PEVA lining and a hard, Under Armor embossed easy-to-clean liner. This strong and sturdy liner is more than just easy to clean, it's also hygienic. Dimensions: 10 inches x 8.25 inches x 4 inches.
